name: Acquia ContentHub Subscriber
description: Provides subscriber controls and tools for Acquia ContentHub.
project_description:
Acquia Content Hub is a cloud-based, centralized content distribution and syndication solution that enables customers to effectively publish, reuse, and syndicate content across a network of Drupal websites.

 Installation Instructions & Support 
 Make sure you use composer to install this module. Downloading the tarball from drupal.org will not work. Additionally, Content Hub tests against and supports the current major and minor version of Drupal as well as the previous minor release.

 

composer config repositories.drupal composer https://packages.drupal.org/8

composer require drupal/acquia_contenthub:~3

 

 Versions of Drupal that are two or more minor releases behind may still function, but are not covered in our testing. Acquia always recommends upgrading to the latest stable minor version of Drupal for the best product experience with Content Hub.

 
 Acquia Personalization (formerly known as Lift) Support 
 Acquia Personalization no longer requires Content Hub. Please contact your Acquia account manager to discuss migrating to the new Personalization module .

 
 
 Acquia Content Hub 1.x and 2.x have reached end-of-life 
 The 1.x version and the 2.x version of the Acquia Content Hub module have reached end-of-life and are no longer supported for use with the Acquia Content Hub service.

 
 
 Acquia ContentHub S3 Support has ended 
 Acquia ContentHub S3 submodule of Acquia ContentHub is deprecated from Acquia ContentHub 3.9.0 (i.e. abandoned), and no longer being developed. Product integration with S3 File System will no longer be supported.
